section.content: The utility model belongs to the technical field of battery production and manufacture, and particularly relates to a lithium ion battery which comprises a current collector (1); the protective coating (2) is coated on at least one surface of the current collector (1); and the conductive coating (3) is coated on the surface of the protective coating (2). The utility model can inhibit the thermal runaway of the lithium ion battery and is beneficial to improving the safety of the battery.
本实用新型属于电池生产制造的技术领域，具体涉及一种锂离子电池，包括集流体(1)；保护涂层(2)，涂布在所述集流体(1)的至少一面；导电涂层(3)，涂布在所述保护涂层(2)的表面。本实用新型能够抑制锂离子电池热失控，有助于提高电池的安全性。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of battery production and manufacturing, and particularly relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

At the market end of lithium batteries, failure caused by external force is the main reason of ignition of a battery core, the corner positions, the head, the tail and the right side edges are positions with higher failure probability and may be related to use scenes such as falling, piercing by foreign objects, repairing a machine and disassembling a battery, and for the failure reason of piercing by the foreign objects, a test method commonly used in the industry is tail/impact/forced internal short circuit. At present, a coating is coated on the aluminum foil to protect the aluminum foil, so that the aluminum foil is prevented from directly contacting the anode and losing efficacy.

At present, lithium batteries are researched in different directions on a safety battery core, and the use safety of the lithium batteries is researched from the aspects of positive and negative electrode materials, electrolyte, diaphragms, coatings and the like. In the industry, great progress is currently made in applying a security coating on top of the foil, the prior art being based on the fact that the coating is densely covered on the aluminum foil to protect it, which cannot be achieved in some abuse situations.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to: the lithium ion battery can inhibit thermal runaway of the lithium ion battery and is beneficial to improving the safety of the battery.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

a lithium ion battery comprising a current collector; the protective coating is coated on at least one surface of the current collector; and the conductive coating is coated on the surface of the protective coating.

Preferably, the thickness of the conductive coating layer and the thickness of the protective coating layer are 0.1 to 1.0 μm.

Preferably, the peel strength of the conductive coating and the peel strength of the protective coating are greater than 10N/m.

Preferably, the conductive coating comprises a conductive material having a particle size of 0.02 to 1.0 μm.

Preferably, the conductive material is conductive carbon black, carbon nanotubes or graphene.

Preferably, the particle size of the material of the protective coating is 0.02-1.0 μm.

Preferably, the material of the protective coating is a foamed material.

Preferably, the total thickness of the protective coating and the conductive coating is 0.3 to 2.0 μm.

Preferably, the porosity of the protective coating and the conductive coating is less than or equal to 50%.

Preferably, the protective coating or the conductive coating further comprises a flame retardant material.

The utility model has the advantages that the utility model comprises a current collector; the protective coating is coated on at least one surface of the current collector; and the conductive coating is coated on the surface of the protective coating. Under the abuse condition, the existing coating cannot achieve the safety effect, so that a protective coating is coated firstly, then a conductive coating is coated, a compact coating is formed on the surface of a current collector, under the abuse and abnormal heating conditions of a battery core, the coating is covered on the current collector compactly to play a role in protecting an aluminum foil, so that the current collector cannot be in direct contact with an anode, and the risk of short circuit is reduced. The utility model can inhibit the thermal runaway of the lithium ion battery and is beneficial to improving the safety of the battery.

Drawings

Features, advantages and technical effects of exemplary embodiments of the present invention will be described below with reference to the accompanying drawings.

FIG. 1 is a schematic view of the present invention.

Wherein the reference numerals are as follows:

1, current collector;

2-protective coating;

3-conductive coating.

Detailed Description

As used in the specification and in the claims, certain terms are used to refer to particular components. As one skilled in the art will appreciate, manufacturers may refer to a component by different names. This specification and claims do not intend to distinguish between components that differ in name but not function. In the following description and in the claims, the terms "include" and "comprise" are used in an open-ended fashion, and thus should be interpreted to mean "include, but not limited to. "substantially" means within an acceptable error range, and a person skilled in the art can solve the technical problem within a certain error range to substantially achieve the technical effect.

Furthermore, the terms "first," "second," and the like are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance.

In the present invention, unless otherwise expressly specified or limited, the terms "mounted," "connected," "secured," and the like are to be construed broadly and can include, for example, fixed connections, detachable connections, or integrally connected; can be mechanically or electrically connected; they may be connected directly or indirectly through intervening media, or they may be interconnected between two elements. The specific meanings of the above terms in the present invention can be understood by those skilled in the art according to specific situations.

The present invention will be described in further detail with reference to fig. 1, but the present invention is not limited thereto.

Implementation mode one

The following describes embodiment one with reference to fig. 1

A lithium ion battery comprising a current collector 1; the protective coating 2 is coated on at least one surface of the current collector 1; and the conductive coating 3 is coated on the surface of the protective coating 2.

Because the existing coating can not achieve the safety function under some abuse conditions, the protective coating 2 is coated firstly, then the conductive coating 3 is coated, a compact coating is formed on the surface of the current collector 1, under the abuse and abnormal heating conditions of a battery core, the coating is covered on the current collector 1 compactly, the aluminum foil protection function is achieved, the short circuit risk is reduced, compared with other safety coatings, the compact coating is thinner in thickness and beneficial to reducing the energy density loss, the protective coating 2 is coated on the current collector 1 such as an aluminum foil substrate through gravure printing, then the conductive coating 3 is coated on the protective coating 2 through gravure printing, the current collector 1 with the compact coating is obtained, and the coating is covered on the aluminum foil compactly, the aluminum foil protection function is achieved, and the current collector can not be in direct contact with an anode.

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the thickness of the conductive coating layer 3 and the thickness of the protective coating layer 2 are 0.1 to 1.0 μm. The thickness of the conductive coating 3 and the thickness of the protective coating 2 are defined, so that the thickness of the conductive coating 3 or the thickness of the protective coating 2 is prevented from being too thick to influence the energy density of the cell.

In the lithium ion battery, the peeling strength of the conductive coating 3 and the peeling strength of the protective coating 2 are greater than 10N/m, so that the conductive coating 3 or the protective coating 2 is prevented from falling off, and the quality of the battery is improved.

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the conductive coating 3 includes a conductive material having a particle size of 0.02 to 1.0 μm, preventing the particle size of the coating from being too large to affect the performance of the conductive coating 3.

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the conductive material is conductive carbon black, carbon nanotubes or graphene, but the present invention is not limited thereto, and other conductive materials may be used according to actual production and cost requirements.

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the particle size of the material of the protective coating 2 is 0.02 to 1.0 μm, preventing the particle size of the coating from being too large to affect the performance of the conductive coating 3.

The material of the protective coating 2 is a foaming material, the foaming material is a raw material such as plastic (PE, EVA, etc.), rubber (SBR, CR, etc.), and the like, and is added with auxiliary materials such as a catalyst, a foam stabilizer, a foaming agent, and the like, through physical foaming or cross-linking foaming, a large amount of fine foam is generated in the plastic and the rubber, the volume is increased, the density is reduced, the soft foaming material has light weight and good softness, and the soft foaming material has the functions of buffering, sound absorption, shock absorption, heat preservation, filtration, and the like.

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the protective coating 2 or the conductive coating 3 further comprises a flame retardant material, which can exert its flame retardant effect to prevent the battery from failing and igniting and exploding when the battery fails.

The working principle of the utility model is as follows:

the method comprises the steps of firstly coating a protective coating 2, then coating a conductive coating 3, forming a compact coating on the surface of a current collector 1, wherein under the conditions of abuse of a battery core and abnormal heating, the coating is compactly covered on the current collector 1 to play a role of protecting an aluminum foil, so that the current collector cannot be directly contacted with an anode, and the risk of short circuit is reduced.

Second embodiment

The difference from the first embodiment is that: the total thickness of the protective coating 2 and the conductive coating 3 of the embodiment is 0.3-2.0 μm, so that the influence of the excessive thickness of the total thickness of the conductive coating 3 and the protective coating 2 on the energy density of the battery cell is prevented.

Other structures are the same as those in the first embodiment, and are not described again here.

Third embodiment

The difference from the first embodiment is that: the porosity of the protective coating 2 and the conductive coating 3 of the present embodiment is less than or equal to 50%, which limits the porosity of the coating and prevents the protective and conductive effects from failing to achieve the desired effects due to the lack of compactness of the coating.

Other structures are the same as those in the first embodiment, and are not described again here.

Variations and modifications to the above-described embodiments may also occur to those skilled in the art, which fall within the scope of the utility model as disclosed and taught herein. Therefore, the present invention is not limited to the above-mentioned embodiments, and any obvious improvement, replacement or modification made by those skilled in the art based on the present invention is within the protection scope of the present invention. Furthermore, although specific terms are employed herein, they are used in a generic and descriptive sense only and not for purposes of limitation.
